# TTR / TTROS canonical map
## Business model

Time to Revenue (TTR) — the client-facing business. Owner: Liam Duff. Vancouver, BC. TTROS / Agentic OS — the internal operating system that runs TTR. Not a product, not SaaS, not sold to clients.

What TTR does: finds and removes the operational friction inside growing service businesses, then designs and builds the revenue, data, and operations systems that fix it.

Operating model

TTR is run as a two-discipline engineering practice, and sells the same two disciplines:

Forward-deployed engineering — embed inside the client's actual operation, build against their real workflows and real numbers, ship working systems rather than recommendations. Delivery happens in the client's context, not in a deck.
Go-to-market engineering — build the acquisition machine itself: targeting, signal detection, enrichment, outreach, lead response, follow-up, measurement. Revenue treated as a system to be engineered rather than a volume of manual effort.

TTR is its own first deployment. The acquisition engine Liam builds to win TTR's clients is the same class of system TTR sells, and building it is the credential. Capability is proven on TTR before it is charged for.

Stage

Solo founder, pre-vertical, no industry credentials yet. Acquisition is being rebuilt around engineered cold outreach; the prior warm and referral motion has not produced enough volume to rely on. First priority remains two implementation proofs.
